summary: I’m passionate about bringing data to life for clients. That includes blending multiple data sets together to unlock the analytics that are hidden across silos.  I do this through by listening to clients with a steadfast curiosity, uncovering their needs, and exploring the problems they're trying to solve from an analytics perspective. Throughout my career, I've created close partnerships with client architecture and engineering teams to ensure that whatever solutions I've put in place are sustainable.  My approach leverages technology to build out the analytics story, through cloud-native tools and the data that is already available have, plus blending third-party data sources. Essentially, I work with clients to curate an integrated data set that will answer strategic questions.  It’s all about combining data architecture, platform architecture, data engineering, and data governance to align stakeholder goals, produce quality data analytics, and further the organization’s transformational goals.  AREAS OF EXPERTISE Leadership & Management | Data Strategy & Advisory | Cloud Data Platforms | Advanced Analytics | Data Architecture | Data Governance | Data Engineering | Data Virtualization | Artificial Intelligence (AI) | Machine Learning (ML) | Data-Driven Decision-Making | Cross-Functional Collaboration  ADVISORY ACCUMEN Data Strategy Roadmap | Analytics Maturity Roadmap | Cloud Data Platform (People, Process & Technology) | Architectural & Implementation Roadmap  TECHNOLOGY EXPERTISE Enterprise architecture | Data Architecture | Integration Architecture | Master Data Management | Business Process Management | Rules Engines Design/Implementation | Capacity/Contingency Planning | Service/Capability Rationalization

recommendations_received.text: Not only is Mike a pioneer in the data management and analytics space, Mike's military background makes him approach technology in a very disciplined manner, which is vital for a management level technology worker. Mike's consulting meetings with my clients inevitably produced jaw-dropping reactions, as they had solutions to major business problems right at their finger-tips but needed his expertise and insight to find them.

Mike and I worked closely together and I have seen first hand how hard he works.  He is a team player, willing to do what it takes to get the job done.    Mike has a great presence with clients.  He can articulate complex concepts  to the most senior leaders or to the most junior engineers. He has the practical, hands-on background to understand the nuanced and sometimes subtle barriers to success.  His dedication to results, along with a great sense of humor, makes him a pleasure to work with.  I would welcome the opportunity to work with Mike again in the future.

I've been working with Mike for more than three years and all this time he's been surprising me again and again with his kind, friendly and patient guidance in the most complicated projects. Many times he converted my rough straightforward ideas into something elegant, generic and reusable and then helped me to comprehend and implement it. Nothing helps professional growth more than the opportunity to work side-by-side with a real Architect and I'm glad I was given this chance.

Mike has very solid technical background and in depth industry domain knowledge. He is very easy to work with, can work independently also a great team player. His ability of effective communication with business partners/users, unselfishness result-oriented attitude and great cooperation contribute a lots of many my successful projects. I am very happy having him on my team.

Mike is one of most well-rounded technologists I have had the privilege of working with. His wealth and depth of technical, business, and industry knowledge is impressive. He is driven, result-oriented, and highly productive. I found him very easy to work with. He is also a great team player who possesses excellent communication skills. In short, Mike has been a great asset for the data management department at Newedge.

I found Mike to be a highly competent developer and very easy to work with.  He was able to handle any challenge both technical and non-technical that he was faced with.  I would absolutely recommend Mike and am confident that he will exceed expectations.

Michael was the cornerstone of Scholastic Internet Development Group. Without his tireless work none of the projects we worked on could not be completed on time. He balanced his subject matter expertise with personal grace unlike any consultant who ever worked for me.

recommendations_received.author_job_title: Enterprise Data Strategy, Data Governance and Data Management, Consulting, Chief Data & Analytics Officer (CDAO)
recommendations_received.text: I worked closely with Mike during his time as Platform Solution Architect, supporting our enterprise Data Lakehouse Platform initiative. He played an important role in shaping the architecture that allowed us to standardize canonical data models and deliver trusted, governed data products across several healthcare domains. Mike combines strong architectural instincts with the ability to think strategically about how platforms enable real business outcomes. His work helped establish a scalable, configuration-driven foundation for data quality, governance, and analytics that continues to benefit the organization. I would gladly work with Mike again in any enterprise data transformation effort.
